title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy, helping to build balanced and nutritious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for expectant mothers:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to regulate blood sugar and support digestive health.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, protein, and probiotics, supporting bone health and the immune system.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, supporting the development of the fetus.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of the brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting the development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins, minerals, and fiber, supporting the immune system and overall health.

## Combining Pantry Staples for Balanced Meals
To build balanced meals, expectant mothers can combine these international pantry staples with local ingredients. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt, eggs, and leafy greens.
- Lunch: lentils with low-mercury salmon, leafy greens, and citrus.
- Dinner: eggs with leafy greens, citrus, and Greek yogurt.

## Food Safety Considerations
Expectant mothers should be mindful of food safety when preparing and consuming international pantry staples. Some important considerations:
- Cook food thoroughly before consumption.
- Avoid consuming raw or undercooked food.
- Wash hands and utensils before handling food.
- Store food properly to prevent contamination.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can be a great way to build balanced and nutritious meals during pregnancy. Expectant mothers should be mindful of food safety and combine these staples with local ingredients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and recipes, please visit [our website](/planner) or [read more about related topics](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If expectant mothers have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition or health, they should seek help from a healthcare provider or registered dietitian. They can provide personalized advice and guidance to support the health and well-being of both mother and baby.
